summary: Comprehensive test suite covering all major requirements: JUnit/JSON parsing, aggregation, flaky detection, markdown generation, and workflow validation. 17 unit tests + 6 workflow tests; three act integration cases with exact output assertions. Strengths: well-organized (unit vs. integration), good fixture usage, error handling tested, status normalization edge cases (aliases, skipped-doesn't-count-as-flaky). Gaps: no tests for empty results, Unicode in names, very large datasets, floating-point rounding edge cases, or output-file-write failures. String-based assertions on markdown output are specific and appropriate for catching regressions, but could be brittle if format changes. Would catch most bugs; some edge cases may slip through.
